title: VTA Events — Delete — payload
description: A client deletes a draft event the VTA holds. A published event is cancelled, not deleted, so its registrants' receipts keep pointing at something. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

Response.title: VTA Events — Delete — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vta/events/delete/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vta/events/delete/0.1#response.

deleted.description: Always true: the draft and everything of it are gone.
